Description: Hello to Cheers - ECR foundation stack: the 3 container repositories only. Deployed once per environment, before infra/htc-ecs-stack.json (the application/compute stack) ever runs. Long-lived on purpose: unlike the compute stack, this one is not expected to be torn down/rolled back as part of routine deploys, so a failed application-stack deploy can never take these repositories down with it. See docs/github-actions-deployment-implementation.md.

EnvironmentName.Description: Must match the EnvironmentName used for the corresponding application stack (infra/htc-ecs-stack.json) - repository names are derived from it the same way.
